notes: New: Drilling shows when the customer ordered next to when the shop ordered, and lists the longest-waiting customers first.
New: a Texted button on Drilling records when someone last texted the customer.
New: Drilling shows how many days ago the shop ordered each item.
New: Drilling has an appointment filter to show only orders that need scheduling (or only ones with an appointment).
Changed: Drilling buttons are back to Drilled, No drill, Schedule for every order.
Fixed: the "waiting to drill" count on Drilling now matches the search, location and assignee filters.
New: the What's new button (top right) lists recent fixes and features.
New: orders where the customer needs a fitting show a purple "Needs fitting" badge, and Drilling offers Book fitting first.
New: typing several items separated by commas in New order saves one order per item.
Fixed: last quarter's unfinished drilling and open customer orders no longer disappear when a new quarter starts.
Fixed: the Drilling location filter now includes orders set to Both.
Fixed: both locations fit inside the Opening hours popup.
Fixed: a failed form order or weekly backup now sends an email alert.
New: Order Check In page for marking orders as arrived.
New: customer name and phone suggestions from the Square customer list.
